listing.name: Command & Conquer: Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn & Dune 2000 / OpenRA (OpenRA)
listing.summary: Choose Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn or Dune 2000, then let OpenRA prepare the game content on first Play.

steps.title: Choose the game you want to play
steps.instruction: The Windows portable ZIP contains three different players: RedAlert.exe, TiberianDawn.exe and Dune2000.exe. Extract the complete ZIP, then select the player for your chosen game and keep its folder as the working directory. The installer is an alternative; run it deliberately and select the installed player afterward. Server and utility tools are not game players.

steps.title: Finish content setup on first Play
steps.instruction: Choose Play explicitly to open that game’s own content screen. OpenRA can import your original media or offer its minimal content download; review that choice in OpenRA. No content installer or helper is started by discovery or by saving launch details.

steps.title: Keep your upstream profile and update route
steps.instruction: OpenRA or you provide updates. Preserve the actual profile: normally %APPDATA%\OpenRA on Windows, ~/.config/openra on Linux, or ~/Library/Application Support/OpenRA on macOS. A local Support folder, an older profile or a custom override can change it. Keep settings, saves, maps, mods and content together, and retain a working copy when changing versions. These external files are outside Portcove backup and rollback.

steps.title: Use the native upstream launcher on other systems
steps.instruction: On Linux, choose the AppImage for the game you want and prepare it using upstream instructions; retain the game-specific launcher. On macOS, install the desired game application from the disk image and retain its application bundle. These formats use upstream setup; Portcove does not extract or execute an AppImage, disk image, installer or shell helper automatically.
